purpose: Deterministic archive of best-match pairs: Signature AI + Signature robot body. Concept pairings with scores, rationales, and shell-aware demos.
concept_fit_boundary: A high concept-fit score is never approval to build, deploy, or certify a robot. Concept match, technical compatibility, and physical validation are independent statuses.

identities.ai: canonical Signature AI Phone Book IDs

score_method.meaning: documented concept fit only — NOT engineering feasibility, safety rating, production readiness, certification, or physical compatibility
score_method.formula: 55 + int(25 * shared_tags / union_tags) + pair_factor(0..19), capped at 100
factors: capability-tag overlap (AI skills vs body hardware)

ai_rules: DO NOT INVENT records; resolve IDs against the archive
Distinguish ARCHIVE FACT from GENERATED EXPLANATION
Demo dialogue is an interface, not the authoritative record
Never turn concept-fit scores into engineering/safety claims
Missing data -> NOT SPECIFIED / NOT TESTED / UNKNOWN
